course.title: AI for Beginners
course.subtitle: The broad tour: symbolic AI, neural nets from the perceptron up, vision, NLP and ethics.
course.credit_line: Curriculum © Microsoft · MIT License · digested with credit, shared free.
course.after_note: The GenAI and AI Agents petals in this tree take you from here to modern LLM applications.

modules.title: Introduction & symbolic AI
modules.blurb: The history, and the 'good old fashioned AI' that reasoned with symbols.

lessons.title: Introduction and history of AI
lessons.objective: Where AI began and what it promised.
keys: Two traditions: symbolic reasoning and neural learning
Two AI winters: hype wrote checks compute couldn't cash
Today's LLMs are the neural tradition, scaled past recognition

lessons.title: Knowledge representation and expert systems
keys: Knowledge graphs and ontologies: meaning as structure
Expert systems: IF-THEN rules distilled from experts
Symbolic AI is explainable but brittle; neural is fluid but opaque

modules.title: Introduction to neural networks
modules.blurb: Perceptrons, backprop, and frameworks — built from scratch.

lessons.title: The perceptron
lessons.objective: The neuron as a learned decision.
keys: Perceptron: weighted inputs + bias + threshold = decision
Learning = adjusting weights by the error
One neuron draws one line; deep nets draw worlds

lessons.title: Multi-layer perceptron and your own framework
lessons.objective: Build a neural net from first principles.
keys: Stack layers between input and output; nonlinearity is the secret
Backpropagation: calculus blame, distributed backwards
Building your own framework once teaches what PyTorch abstracts

lessons.title: Frameworks — PyTorch and TensorFlow
keys: Tensors + autograd + optimizers = the framework contract
Train/val split exists to catch overfitting, not to decorate notebooks
Overfitting: memorizing the textbook and failing the exam

modules.title: Computer vision
modules.blurb: From OpenCV to CNN architectures, transfer learning, GANs, detection and segmentation.

lessons.title: Intro to computer vision — OpenCV
keys: An image is a tensor of pixels; vision is math on grids
OpenCV: filters, edges, transforms — the pre-deep-learning toolbox
Convolutions detect; pooling summarizes

lessons.title: Convolutional neural networks and architectures
keys: Conv layers learn local patterns; stacking learns hierarchy: edges → parts → objects
LeNet→AlexNet→ResNet: each generation fixed a scaling problem
ResNet's skip connections: let gradients flow or depth dies

lessons.title: Pre-trained networks and transfer learning
keys: Transfer learning: reuse a trained backbone, retrain the head
Freeze, then fine-tune — the two-speed strategy
Data augmentation multiplies your dataset for free

lessons.title: Autoencoders and VAEs
keys: Autoencoder: squeeze through a bottleneck, reconstruct
The bottleneck is the meaning — a learned compression
VAEs make the latent space smooth: sample new examples

lessons.title: Generative adversarial networks and style transfer
keys: GAN: a forger and a detective improving against each other
Training GANs is balancing act — collapse is the default
Style transfer: content from one image, style from another

lessons.title: Object detection
keys: Detection = classification + localization per object
Anchor boxes and IoU: the geometry of 'found it'
YOLO trades a little accuracy for a lot of speed

lessons.title: Semantic segmentation — U-Net
keys: Segmentation: per-pixel classification, image understanding's endgame
U-Net: encode context, decode precision, skip the middle
Medicine and self-driving live on segmentation

modules.title: Natural language processing
modules.blurb: From bag-of-words to Transformers and few-shot LLMs.

lessons.title: Text representation — BoW and TF-IDF
keys: Bag-of-words: presence as meaning, order discarded
TF-IDF rewards the rare and punishes the common
Representations decide ceilings — choose them consciously

lessons.title: Word embeddings — Word2Vec and GloVe
keys: Embeddings put meaning into vectors: king − man + woman ≈ queen
Similar words cluster; analogies are directions
Embeddings power search, recommendations, RAG — everything

lessons.title: Language modeling and training embeddings
keys: Language modeling: guess the next token — the game that ate the world
CBOW/skip-gram train embeddings on cheap supervision
Every LLM is this lesson, scaled a billion times

lessons.title: Recurrent neural networks
keys: RNNs carry a hidden state across time steps
Vanishing gradients: long memories fade
LSTM/GRU gates fight forgetting — imperfectly

lessons.title: Generative recurrent networks
keys: Character-level generation: the model dreams one letter at a time
Temperature: the creativity dial
Sampling loops: output becomes input becomes output

lessons.title: Transformers and BERT
keys: Attention: every token looks at every token — no recurrence
Positional encodings restore the order attention forgot
BERT reads both ways; GPT writes one way; the world split in two

lessons.title: Named entity recognition
keys: NER: tag entities token by token (BIO scheme)
Structured extraction turns text into databases
NER is where NLP meets business value first

lessons.title: Large language models and prompt programming
keys: Scale changed behavior: few-shot learning emerged uninvited
Prompting is programming the model in its own language
This lesson is the bridge to the GenAI petal

modules.title: Other AI techniques
modules.blurb: Evolution and reward: the roads less traveled.

lessons.title: Genetic algorithms
keys: Selection, crossover, mutation: optimize anything with a fitness score
Populations explore in parallel where gradient descent walks one path
Great where gradients don't exist — schedules, architectures, art

lessons.title: Deep reinforcement learning
keys: Deep RL: neural nets approximating value or policy
Explore/exploit and the sparse-reward desert
RL wins games; the real world is still mostly supervised

lessons.title: Multi-agent systems
keys: Simple agents + local rules = complex collective behavior
Emergence: the flock is smarter than the bird
The intellectual ancestor of today's multi-agent LLMs

modules.title: AI ethics & extras
modules.blurb: The chapter that makes the rest safe to use.

lessons.title: AI ethics and responsible AI
keys: Responsible AI principles: fairness, reliability, privacy, inclusiveness, transparency, accountability
Every design decision is an ethical decision wearing overalls
The last lesson is the one the field keeps failing

lessons.title: Multi-modal networks — CLIP and VQGAN
lessons.objective: Images and text in one space.
keys: CLIP: one embedding space for pixels and words
Cross-modal search: query images with sentences
Multimodality is where AI stops being blind
